sentences.text: Shri Rajesh Yadav - Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Prashant Jain - G.A. for the respondent/State.

Heard on I.A.No.4018/2026, which is an application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C. for temporary suspension of custodial sentence and grant of bail to the appellant on the ground of death of his grandmother.

The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 363, 366 and 376(2)(N) of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs. 4,000/-, R.I. for 3 years with fine of Rs.4,000/- and R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- with default stipulations.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the grandmother of the appellant has died and being a grandson, appellant's presence is very much necessary.
Hence, it is prayed that appellant be released on temporary bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the State submits that the factum of death of grandmother of the appellant has not been verified.
Considering the aforesaid circumstances, without expressing any opinion on the merits, application is hereby allowed for a period of ten days from the date of his release.

The custodial sentence of the appellant is temporarily suspended subject to verification of death of grandmother of the appellant by the learned trial Court concerned and it is directed that he be released on temporary bail for a period of ten days on furnishing bail bond in 2 CRA-7442-2022 the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court subject to the condition that he shall surrender after completion of ten days from the date of his release before the trial Court concerned for being committed to custody.
In case of non-surrender, the learned trial Court shall be free to take any coercive action against the appellant to ensure his surrender before the trial Court.
I.A. No.4019/2026, an application for urgent hearing also stands disposed of.
List the case on 28.04.2026 along with surrender report.
